messages.text: I'll pull up the order first.

Nothing has shipped, and I've put a hold on the order so it stays put while we sort this out.

Your Magic M. 40T, with the Miner D. and Power K., is a pre-order: a unit is being built for you, and what you paid has gone into that specific build. It ships November 30.

If you'd rather not wait on it, I can move the full amount to store credit on your account, usable right away on anything we have in stock, or swap you to an in-stock miner instead.

Which sounds better?

That's the one I'm looking at, Shop····, paid, nothing shipped, held for now.

It's the Magic M. 40T with the Miner D. and Power K., $734.65, shipping November 30.

So tell me which way you want to go: keep the order and wait for the unit that's being built for you, move the full $734.65 to store credit you can spend today on anything in stock, or swap it for an in-stock miner now. Happy to price the swap options out for you.

Understood, and I'm sorry. You ordered back on August 9 and the date has moved more than once. That's a long wait and it isn't what we promised you.

Two things worth knowing before you decide. Your unit is in the batch the factory finishes this month, so it's close now. And store credit keeps every dollar of the $734.65 available to you immediately, on anything on the shelf today, with no waiting at all.

If neither works for you, say so and I'll keep going.

One last thing I can put in front of you, and then I'll stop pushing.

Keep the order and we refund $100 of it back to your original payment. You'd have paid $634.65 for the 40T with the Duster and Power K., and the unit still comes to you on November 30.

That's the only version where you keep the miner and get money back. Want me to put that through?

That's clear, and I'll stop offering.

I should be straight with you: cancelling isn't something we do as a matter of course here, and it isn't mine to approve. If you'd still like to go ahead, the request goes to a supervisor for review, and they come back to you on it.

Your order stays held in the meantime, so nothing ships while it's being looked at.

I'm sorry it came to this after the wait you've had.
